newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CONSERVATIVE MPS IN SUDDEN MEETING - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CONSERVATIVE MPS IN SUDDEN MEETING - SOURCE.

text.p: The Finnish conservative party MPs on Thursday started an extra group meeting after a government proposal on freer opening hours was voted down by the legislature, a party official told Reuters by telephone.
"They went into a meeting, I would not call it a crisis meeting but they have to review the situation," the official said.
Parliament's rejection of the proposal with 84 votes against it and 82 in favour came as a surprise to the party, she said.
